package log

import (
	"strings"
	"time"
)

func ShortDur(d time.Duration) string {
	var s string
	switch {
	case d > time.Hour:
		s = d.Round(time.Minute).String()
	case d > time.Minute:
		s = d.Round(time.Second).String()
	case d > time.Second:
		s = d.Round(10 * time.Millisecond).String()
	case d > time.Millisecond:
		s = d.Round(100 * time.Microsecond).String()
	default:
		s = d.String()
	}
	if strings.HasSuffix(s, "m0s") {
		s = s[:len(s)-2]
	}
	if strings.HasSuffix(s, "h0m") {
		s = s[:len(s)-2]
	}
	return s
}

item.text:
Implemented reverse proxy login in the checked-out repository. `ReverseProxyWhitelist` accepts comma-separated IPv4 and IPv6 CIDRs, individual addresses, and `@` for Unix sockets; an empty list disables the feature. Trusted requests use `ReverseProxyUserHeader` (default `Remote-User`) to find or create the user, update `LastLoginAt`, and return a session payload to the UI. Untrusted requests receive no `auth` payload. Nested log map values are redacted while their keys remain intact.

Verification: `go test ./...` and the new frontend session tests passed. The frontend build passed with `NODE_OPTIONS=--openssl-legacy-provider`; the default build command failed because this repository’s webpack version is incompatible with Node 20’s default OpenSSL settings. The command and error are recorded in [checkpoint.md](/app/.codex-role-output/checkpoint.md).
